key.description: Unique identifier for the game, includes the title and developer in brackets.

status.description: Current development status of the game (e.g., Abandoned, Completed, Ongoing, Onhold).

url.description: Direct link to the game’s thread or page on the source site.

bayesian_rating.description: Normalized rating of the game using a Bayesian average to account for varying number of reviews.

site_rating.description: Average rating given on the original site.

site_rating_count.description: Number of ratings submitted on the site.

play_time_hours.description: Estimated time to play the game, in hours.

overall_sentiment.description: Aggregated sentiment score for the game based on user feedback and reviews.

overall_sentiment_label.description: Human-readable label for the overall sentiment score

art_sentiment.description: Sentiment score reflecting opinions on the game’s visual presentation, art style, animations, and overall visual quality.

art_sentiment_label.description: Human-readable label for the art sentiment score

story_sentiment.description: Sentiment score reflecting opinions on the game’s story, writing quality, characters, pacing, and narrative structure.

story_sentiment_label.description: Human-readable label for the story sentiment score.

content_sentiment.description: Sentiment score reflecting opinions on the game’s content, including themes, fetishes/tags, variety, and depth of available content.

content_sentiment_label.description: Human-readable label for the content sentiment score.

gameplay_sentiment.description: Sentiment score reflecting opinions on the game’s mechanics, controls, level design, difficulty, and overall gameplay experience.

gameplay_sentiment_label.description: Human-readable label for the gameplay sentiment score.

engine.description: The game engine used (e.g., Ren’Py, Unity).

site_std_version.description: Standardized version format derived from the site’s version number.

site_version.description: The version string as listed on the site.

site_last_update_date.description: Date when the game was last updated on the site.

site_release_date.description: Original release date of the game.

developer.description: Name of the game’s developer or team.

platforms.description: Platforms supported by the game (e.g., Windows, Mac, Linux, Android).

is_vn.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the game is a visual novel (True/False).

censored.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the game is censored (True/False).

site tag: turn based combat.description: Site tag from f95zone: 'turn based combat'

site tag: no sexual content.description: Site tag from f95zone: 'no sexual content'

similarity_score.description: Numeric score representing the similarity of this game to the selected reference game, where 0 means no similarity and 100 means identical.
